title: Disk index of review-runs directories (read-only)
outcome:
Resolve Git's review-runs path as the launcher does (git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-path review-runs, scripts/test-launcher.mjs:199); list run dirs; read request.json (owner, stages, expectedFingerprint) and results.json; merge with records (host-started runs win); mark not-host-started runs read-only. Bounded: at most M newest dirs per root.

REVIEW FIXES (F9, F5): index at most M = 50 newest run dirs per root; owner from request.json (host runs populate it via TERMAL_SESSION_ID); a results.json 'running' whose pid is alive with matching identity counts as an active CLI-started run for admission; a dead-pid 'running' is unknown and never blocks; malformed files -> entry unknown with a parse reason.

OUTPUT TO FILE (Greg, 2026-09-23): the record carries host_log_path for host-started runs; the disk index leaves it empty for CLI-started runs.
acceptance:
- A CLI-started run dir appears with owner from request.json and cannot be canceled/rerun (409).
- Malformed request/results.json -> listed as unknown with a parse reason, no panic.
- At most 50 newest dirs per root are indexed; a dead-pid running results.json is reported unknown and does not block admission.
